# William Crawford — Las Vegas & Henderson Real Estate Agent

> William Crawford is a licensed Nevada real estate agent (License S.0200576) with Huntington & Ellis, A Real Estate Agency (Broker: Craig M. Tann). He helps buyers and sellers in Las Vegas, Henderson, Summerlin and nearby communities, with video-first home marketing.

Contact: billy@huntingtonandellis.com · +1 725-567-9482
Website: https://williamcluxury.com
